name: sgtm
description: Server-side Google Tag Manager (tagging + preview), meant to sit behind a same-origin proxy

env.name: SGTM_CONTAINER_CONFIG
env.prompt: Container config string (GTM server container → Admin → Container settings)

env.name: SGTM_DIRECT_MATCH
env.prompt: Optional: direct browser access without a proxy, as a Traefik matcher (empty = proxy only; e.g. (Path(`/g/collect`) || PathPrefix(`/gtm/`)))

env.name: SGTM_GCP_SA_JSON_B64
env.prompt: Optional: Google service account JSON key, base64 (BigQuery/Firestore from tags)
